# List time entries — `redmine_list_time_entries`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_read-only_

Query logged time by user, project, issue, date range, or activity — used for timesheet review ("what did I log this week") and billing/reporting.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `user_id` | string | no | User id whose entries to list, or "me". |
| `project_id` | string | no | Scope to a project id or identifier slug. |
| `issue_id` | string | no | Scope to a single issue id. |
| `spent_on` | string | no | Exact spent-on date, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". Use from/to for ranges. |
| `from` | string | no | Start of a spent-on date range, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| `to` | string | no | End of a spent-on date range, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| `activity_id` | string | no | Filter by activity id (e.g. Development, Design). |
| `sort` | string | no | Sort column, optionally with ":desc", e.g. "spent_on:desc". |
| `offset` | integer | no | Pagination offset (skip N entries). |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of entries to return. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_list_time_entries",
  "arguments": {
    "user_id": "42"
  }
}
```
